about: Havener Logistics is a trusted provider of specialized cargo handling solutions across the GCC region, offering expert services in lashing, packing, and shipping. With a focus on safety, precision, and timely delivery, we ensure cargo of all sizes and complexities is securely transported across borders.
Specializing multicar, SUV, Pickup, Van, Yatch, 2 wheelers and truck and heavy vehicle lashing. Our team with decades of experiance are expert in multi vehicle lashing.
